messages:
Nina Patel: Hi team, quick one. Took Eurostar from London to Paris for customer meetings and the conductor only gave me a VAT-free paper receipt with no VAT breakdown. The corporate card was charged in GBP and my bank shows the charge converted to EUR on settlement. Expense form wants an itemized VAT line for reclaim. Can finance accept the paper receipt + bank statement, or do I need a specific invoice from Eurostar?
Maria Gomez: Thanks for flagging. For travel, we accept the vendor's final invoice or itemized receipt. If the vendor only provides a VAT-free receipt, we need the bank statement showing the posted charge AND a short note explaining vendor policy. If VAT reclaim is required for bookkeeping, Travel Ops can request an invoice from Eurostar.
Nina Patel: The conductor said Eurostar doesn't issue VAT invoices for cross-border fares, only a travel receipt. I can put the seat reservation fee breakdown screenshot from my account page, but it isn't an official invoice. Will that suffice?
Train Ops: Eurostar's merchant policy is weird. For cross-border passenger fares VAT often not applied in the same way. If the company needs a full invoice for VAT purposes, we escalate to vendor support. Otherwise finance typically reimburses the posted amount with receipts + bank statement. Please add the booking confirmation PDF, the conductor receipt photo, and the bank line.
Maria Gomez: Correct. Submit the expense as "travel - transport" and attach: 1) booking confirmation PDF, 2) conductor receipt photo, 3) bank statement showing posted GBP->EUR conversion, and 4) a one-line explanation: "Vendor does not issue VAT invoices for cross-border passenger fares." We'll code the expense as non-VAT reclaimable unless Travel Ops obtains an invoice.
Nina Patel: Posted now. Also curious: the bank converted at a rate that added \u20ac4.50 in FX markup compared to the in-app conversion shown at booking. Do we reimburse FX markup or just the posted EUR amount?
Finance Bot: Policy: "Finance reimburses actual posted bank charges in the currency shown on your statement. FX markup from personal cards is not reimbursed if the corporate card was available. If the corporate card could not be used (declined), submit a note and we may approve both the base charge and any unavoidable bank conversion fees. See https://intranet.redwood/fin/fx-policy."
Maria Gomez: Since you used the corp card, we'll reimburse the posted EUR equivalent on the bank transaction. No additional FX markup reimbursement. If Travel Ops can get Eurostar to issue an invoice in EUR showing net fare, we'll mark accordingly, but that rarely happens.
Nina Patel: Thanks all, uploading bank screenshot and booking PDF now. Appreciate the quick guidance.
